nodes.name: Substrate Cleaning and Preparation
nodes.procedure: FTO glass was ultrasonically cleaned with ethanol and DI water for 10 min each and dried with compressed air. Ni foil was similarly cleaned, then electropolished in 15 mL of 50 wt% H2SO4 at 500 mA for 60s (30s per side), rinsed, and dried. PDMS (8:1 base to curing agent) was applied to Ni foil, exposing 1cm2, and cured at 40 C for 2h.

nodes.name: Electrodeposition of Metal Hydroxides
nodes.procedure: 20 mM transition metal nitrate solutions (Ni(NO3)2 for Ni(OH)2, Co(NO3)2 for Co(OH)2, and 10 mM each for NiCo(OH)2) were prepared in DI water and stirred for 2h at 25 C. The pH was adjusted to 3 using 1M HNO3. Electrodeposition was performed at 1 mA/cm2 using a two-electrode setup with graphite or Ni foam as counter electrode. Metal hydroxide on FTO substrate electrodeposition time was 15 or 30 s, and on nickel foil was 300 s. Electrodes were rinsed and dried with compressed air.

nodes.name: Preparation of Ni-CV Electrode
nodes.procedure: Ni foil was subjected to 1000 (or 2000 as mentioned in Note 2.7) CV cycles in 1M KOH within the potential range of 1.10-1.68 V at a scan rate of 20 mV/s without iR compensation to form a thick NiOxHy layer.
nodes.source_text: To prepare Ni-CV samples, CV electrochemical treatment was performed at 20 mV/s in the potential range of 1.10-1.68 V without compensation for 1000 times.
